name: Symbol of Despair, Lesser
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level cleric/oracle 2, lathspell 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Components V, S, M (mercury and phosphorous, plus powdered diamond and opal worth a total of 100 gp)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as symbol of despair, except for the above and affected creatures are subject to the doubting condition. Additionally the symbol remains active for 1 round per caster level.

Lesser symbol of despair can be made permanent with a permanency spell by a caster of 10th level or higher for the cost of 5,000 gp.
